Contract ProcessSaleService::enterItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentSale: Sale = CurrentSale,
		item: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(o|o.Barcode = barcode),
		saleLine: SalesLineItem = SalesLineItem.allInstance()->any(o|o.BelongedSale = currentSale and
		o.BelongedItem = item),
		isCurrentSaleComplete: Boolean = currentSale.IsComplete,
		itemInStock: Boolean = item.StockNumber>0
	precondition:
		currentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		isCurrentSaleComplete = false and
		item.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		itemInStock = true
	postcondition:
		let saleLine: SalesLineItem in
		saleLine.BelongedSale = currentSale and
		saleLine.BelongedItem = item and
		saleLine.Quantity = quantity and
		item.StockNumber = item.StockNumber-quantity and
		saleLine.Subamount = item.Price*quantity and
		SaleLine.items->includes(saleLine) and
		result = true
}
